---
name: A device is missing
about: You can't find your device, or only a close match
title: "Missing: <manufacturer> <model>"
labels: device
---

**Device:** manufacturer and model, as on the sticker on the back

**What it is:** TV, receiver, streamer, disc player...

**How it's controlled:** infrared remote, Bluetooth, or not sure

**Closest match you found:** if any, and whether it works

**Anything else:** a link to the device, or its remote's model number
